Scope: BOI only; both signs. IOSI excluded. Outcome priorities are proposed, not scientifically accepted.
AggregationRule: Record per-recording ingredients first; animal-level inference requires a comparison-specific plan.

Measurements.Name: Relative optical event amplitude
Measurements.Question: How pronounced is the preserved-input optical change?
Measurements.Formula: q(t)=(mean preserved-input intensity on fixed event footprint - B0)/(B0-O); sink=-min(q); surge=max(q); percent=100*fraction
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Fixed union of native event pixels, traced through preserved input TIFF. B0 is mean of immediately preceding round(baselineSec*SampleF) clean samples; default 20 seconds. Original automatic fields keep their immediate-window reference. EpisodeAmplitudePercent is a separate derived sink measurement: intersecting consecutive native runs at one site with empty gaps <20 s share the first event reference interval, sampled on each event footprint. The configured full baseline length and both-sign native exclusion remain. Shift >20 s, unclear recording-start recovery, contamination or missing signal withholds the derived reference. O is the user-supplied camera offset in original counts. Only the denominator is offset-corrected.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Exclude baseline frames overlapping detected support of either sign. All requested clean pre-event samples are required; no post-event replacement. Peak uses saved event bounds.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: BaselineStatus and BaselineValidSamples distinguish missing clean context from zero. Negative directional amplitude stays negative; hypoxic composite rejects it. A reference at or below O makes the ratio unavailable.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Relative optical signal only. Clean means free of detected overlap, not proven free of biological change. Smooth/subthreshold predecessors may contaminate it.
Measurements.Implementation: helpers/finalizeOxygenEventMeasurements.m: NormOxySinkAmp / NormOxySurgeAmp and percent columns; helpers/deriveBOIPreEpisodeReferences.m; helpers/attachSavedBOIEpisodeReferences.m
Measurements.ImplementationStatus: implemented with baseline availability; scientific validity conditional; original automatic amplitude retained; separate versioned pre-episode sink reference available for burden
Measurements.WorkedExample: With an explicitly supplied zero offset, the original worked example applies. Teaching only: B0=100, minimum=80 gives sink amplitude 0.2 or 20%; signed change remains -0.2.

Measurements.Name: Signed trace integral
Measurements.Question: What signed optical change accumulates over the event interval?
Measurements.Formula: sum over saved event frames((I(t)-B0)/(B0-O)) / SampleF
Measurements.SignalAndBaseline: Same preserved-input fixed footprint and clean pre-event baseline as BOI-M06. O is the user-supplied camera offset in original counts. Only the denominator is offset-corrected.
Measurements.SupportAndExposure: Uniform frame-interval rectangle sum, not trapezoidal endpoint integration. Saved event bounds, not area-time weighting.
Measurements.MissingnessAndIdentity: Unavailable baseline/event signal gives NaN. Preserve signed results and sign-specific summaries separately. A reference at or below O makes the ratio unavailable.
Measurements.ClaimLimits: Relative optical trace integral; not oxygen deficit, delivered oxygen or damage. Within-event sign cancellation is visible in its trace.
Measurements.WorkedExample: With an explicitly supplied zero offset, the original worked example applies. Teaching only: two -0.2 samples at 2 Hz integrate to -0.2 fraction*seconds.
